title: An open morphism is generizing, and a universally open morphism is universally generizing
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that an open morphism of schemes lifts generalizations, and that a universally open morphism does so after every base change (statement lines 4518-4529). The counted proof is short and complete: it reduces a given specialization with a chosen point above it to affine charts containing the relevant points, where the statement becomes the going down criterion for open ring maps, and the universal version follows because base changes of an open morphism are open (proof lines 4531-4542). It is H2: the reduction and both conclusions are carried out in the counted span, with the cited input being the affine going down criterion.
